rows.grounds: object to be drawn; compound of yoni and dvaya
specifies method of forming the pair; compound with ablative sense

items.question: Where and by what method must the pair of yonis be placed in the ritual diagram?
premises: A pair of yonis is to be made.
The placement occurs in the middle of the diagram.
The formation follows the arrangement of transverse lines.
items.inference: The practitioner must draw a pair of yonis in the middle by arranging transverse lines.
items.plain_english: Then, in the middle, one should make a pair of yonis by arranging transverse lines.
